name: LP333 ID3 singleton-to-triple unary row channel
hypothesis: Exposing the exact row-sum relation between each canonical singleton pattern and the number of negative size-three orbits with a uniquely extended unary counter will reduce the 300-second conflict count by at least 20 percent and may produce terminal evidence.
evidence_unit: one unrestricted fixed-ID3 full-PAF formula with the existing singleton-translation quotient and one redundant conditional unary row channel per sequence
claim_boundary: A terminal result decides only fixed multiplier family ID3 and its separately normalized coherent translates. Workload performance alone decides no family and no result decides unrestricted LP333 or H668.

baseline.evidence: Code commit 79cb507 and the hash-bound singleton-translation run manifest.
baseline.measurement: The parent formula remains UNKNOWN at 300 seconds after 2659000 conflicts and 2053017228 propagations, with 914620416 bytes peak observed RSS and a 1064658979-byte incomplete proof payload.

intervention.one_change: Retain every parent PAF PB equation, singleton-translation blocking clause, and lex leader, then append one uniquely extended sequential unary prefix counter up to threshold 56 over the 108 size-three orbit bits in each sequence. Block the 11 canonical singleton patterns incompatible with row magnitude 1, and condition the counter terminal signals on each of the 19 row-feasible canonical patterns so the exact triple-negative count is 55, 54, or 53 as forced by the row sum.
forbidden_confounds: changed decimation or sequence-swap lex leaders

controls.name: row-arithmetic-implication
controls.purpose: Prove that every case clause follows from the existing normalized row constraint.
controls.expected: For singleton negative count k and size-three negative count t, k+3t is 166 or 167; the 19 canonical feasible patterns have exactly the allowed pairs (1,55), (2,55), (4,54), (5,54), (7,53), or (8,53), while the remaining 11 canonical patterns are impossible.

controls.name: prefix-counter-truth-table
controls.purpose: Detect a broken nonasserting unary counter or nonunique auxiliary extension.
controls.expected: Exhaustive small input assignments have exactly one auxiliary extension and every terminal signal equals the corresponding at-least threshold.

controls.name: independent-clause-reconstruction
controls.purpose: Bind the exact added block without importing the generator.
controls.expected: An independent auditor reconstructs every counter and conditional clause, matches the serialized contiguous block, and rejects a one-literal mutation.

controls.name: parent-formula-binding
controls.purpose: Hold the unrestricted full-PAF singleton-canonicalized formula fixed.
controls.expected: The parent hash is 0ea4f87736db6d1076214d8378e4f66e1fe499291d5f4d0d406209a7779172b8, has all 116 PAF representatives and no prescribed profile, with identical primary variables, lex leaders, and singleton block before the channel.

controls.name: paper-to-levers-boundary
controls.purpose: Keep the imported mechanism separate from local performance evidence.
controls.expected: Metadata cites the primary unary-cardinality sources and adopts only their unit-propagation mechanism, not published runtime ratios.

controls.name: adversarial-proof-control
controls.purpose: Detect a proof checker that accepts false terminal evidence.
controls.expected: Pinned drat-trim rejects an empty proof against the known SAT control before and after every decisive UNSAT replay.

terminal_outcomes.promote: Every implication, truth-table, reconstruction, parent-binding, paper-boundary, and proof control passes, and the run yields a direct-audited SAT model or a complete independently replayed UNSAT proof.
terminal_outcomes.park: The run is valid but nonterminal and its conflict count exceeds 2127200, so the channel misses its preregistered workload floor.
terminal_outcomes.unknown: The conflict floor passes but the formula reaches a wall, memory, proof-volume, or verification ceiling without terminal evidence.
terminal_outcomes.audit-failed: Any arithmetic implication, truth table, clause reconstruction, parent binding, semantic comparison, model audit, proof replay, or bogus-proof control fails.

stop_rules: Stop before the target run unless the exact 19 feasible singleton cases and their triple counts are independently rederived.
Stop before the target run unless exhaustive small truth tables and exact serialized clause reconstruction pass.
Stop before the target run if any parent PAF row, singleton quotient clause, lex leader, solver option, or source binding changes.
Terminate at 300 solver seconds, 4 GiB observed RSS, or 1 GiB proof bytes.
Do not interpret or replay an incomplete proof.
Do not raise the cap after a nonterminal result.

next_actions.promote: Archive and independently recheck the terminal result; if a direct LP333 pair appears, construct and verify H668.
next_actions.park: Archive the valid negative workload result and move to another fixed family or a proof-logged programmatic PAF propagator.
next_actions.unknown: Preserve the strict-UNKNOWN manifest and select a distinct structural mechanism.
next_actions.audit-failed: Repair only the smallest implication or encoding gate and regenerate in a fresh directory.

authority.data_scope: Local public-prompt artifacts and source-pinned repositories are authorized for the eight-hour autonomous campaign.
authority.external_actions: A fully audited H668 candidate may be prepared for submission; an actual external form action remains gated by exact destination, artifact, account, and contract terms.
